pilot.name: baltimore-canyon
pilot.notes: v1 ships flat GeoJSON over the existing GEBCO 2026 15-arc-second raster-derived grid because tippecanoe PBF tiling is blocked (no-root apt, libsqlite3-dev unavailable). The LOD switching logic + zoom/coverage thresholds + cross-fade + abort-on-region-switch all work end-to-end on the dev preview. Visual detail is GEBCO-grade (~450 m cells, ~25 m smoothed contours) — NOT NOAA-grade canyon morphology. v2 swaps the URLs for tippecanoe-built {z}/{x}/{y}.pbf sourced from NOAA BlueTopo (1/3 arc-second) + NCEI multibeam (1 m) — the controller already detects the URL pattern and routes to the PBF loader. v2 source candidates confirmed: BlueTopo bucket is noaa-ocs-nationalbathymetry-pds.s3.amazonaws.com/BlueTopo/; NCEI multibeam cruises intersecting the bbox include NOAA Okeanos EX1404L2 (Our Deepwater Backyard), EX1206 (NE/Mid-Atlantic Canyons), EX1302, and NF-13-09. NCEI Bathymetric Data Viewer is the canonical selector (https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/maps/bathymetry/?layers=multibeam). BlueTopo fills deeper-than-200-m gaps with GMRT — accept that, don't upsampling it. NOS BAG catalog entries also intersect the bbox (1-2 m shelf surveys like H11554/H11555/H11873, plus 111 m W00358 offshore); BAGs are gap-fill, not the primary canyon source.

coarse.source: GEBCO 2026 15-arc-second subset, baked into dashboard/data/gebco_bath_latest/gebco_bathy.json at runtime

source_priority_v2: NOAA NCEI multibeam surveys intersecting bbox

mosaic_files_v2.name: NOAA Office of Coast Survey BlueTopo
mosaic_files_v2.format: multilayer floating-point GeoTIFF with companion Raster Attribute Table (.tiff.aux.xml); use the dated BlueTopo tile-scheme GeoPackage to resolve tile_id
mosaic_files_v2.vertical_datum: national vertical datum; confirm the exact datum from each tile's metadata before mosaicking
mosaic_files_v2.license: U.S. public domain; NOAA Coast Survey acknowledgement requested

mosaic_files_v2.name: NOAA NCEI Bathymetric Data Viewer — multibeam survey selection for pilot bbox
mosaic_files_v2.format: survey-dependent raw multibeam vendor files and processed XYZ/GeoTIFF/ASCII grids where supplied
mosaic_files_v2.license: NOAA-distributed data; verify contributor metadata, attribution, and datum per survey

source_priority_v2: NOAA NCEI multibeam (highest-resolution surveys for Baltimore Canyon)
NOAA NOS hydrographic BAGs where survey density is sparse

mosaic_files_v2.name: NOAA Okeanos Explorer EX1404L2 — Our Deepwater Backyard: Exploring the Atlantic Canyons and Seamounts
mosaic_files_v2.format: Kongsberg EM302 raw multibeam (.all.mb58.gz), processed generic XYZ soundings (.mb162), and originator-provided 25 m WGS84 grids (GeoTIFF/XYZ/ESRI ASCII)
mosaic_files_v2.native_cell_size: 25 m for the confirmed originator-provided grid; full-resolution sounding spacing varies
mosaic_files_v2.license: NOAA Office of Ocean Exploration and Research data; U.S. public domain with NOAA attribution requested

mosaic_files_v2.name: NOAA Okeanos Explorer EX1206 — Northeast and Mid-Atlantic Canyons Exploration
mosaic_files_v2.format: Kongsberg EM302 multibeam survey archive; inspect the NCEI survey record for available raw and processed deliverables
mosaic_files_v2.license: NOAA data; U.S. public domain with NOAA attribution requested

mosaic_files_v2.name: NOAA Ship Nancy Foster NF-13-09 — Deepwater Canyons 2013: Benthic Lander Recovery
mosaic_files_v2.format: Kongsberg EM1002 raw multibeam vendor files (.all.mb56.gz)
mosaic_files_v2.license: NOAA Office of Ocean Exploration and Research data; U.S. public domain with NOAA attribution requested

mosaic_files_v2.name: NOAA National Ocean Service Hydrographic Survey BAG archive
mosaic_files_v2.format: Bathymetric Attributed Grid (BAG), optionally converted by NCEI to ASCII XYZ with XML metadata
mosaic_files_v2.native_cell_size: survey-dependent; bbox catalog query returned 1 m, 2 m, and 111 m BAG surfaces
mosaic_files_v2.vertical_datum: MLLW for recent post-1980 NOS surveys; confirm per-survey metadata
mosaic_files_v2.license: NOAA data; U.S. public domain with NOAA attribution requested
